summary: Phase D M1 (Expo web preview, 390x844) tested end to end. SHOP passes: categories and products, all-products search, product page variants (9 900 / 14 900), add + stepper, guest device cart, merge into /api/shop/cart/me at login, checkout via POST /api/shop/checkout (COD), /order/shop/<id> timeline, Activity row. SEND single-drop passes: pickup prefilled, Plateau search, vehicles with images and prices matching /quote/parcel, fare breakdown, details form, scheduled slot, booking, track screen with send-live over the authenticated WS (first frame is a snapshot), cancel → Annulée, Activity → /send/track/<id>. Backend WS security passes: snapshot, ping→pong, 403 for empty/bad/other-customer token, legacy socket unchanged. CRITICAL: multi-stop booking is broken in both paths. Live driver push NOT TESTED because the test driver account is not approved.

critical.issue: Backend only uses stops[] when service_type=='multiple_shipments'. For moto with 2 drops the app shows the multi_stop quote (bike 4 608 CFA) but the booking is priced as a single trip from pickup to the last drop (3 168 CFA) and stops=null. Customer is shown one price and charged another, and stop 1 is lost. Reproduced via the UI (exp_f44dd36afa4c4e23) and in pytest.

Returns 400 multi_stop_head_mismatch. book.tsx sends top-level drop = drops[last], but the backend requires stops[0].drop == top-level drop. Multi-shipments booking cannot be created from the app (UI only shows the alert 'HTTP 400').

minor.issue: The server calls ws.close(4403) before accept, so the client gets an HTTP 403 handshake failure (browser close code 1006), not 4403. The 4403 branch in useBookingSocket never runs. Unauthorized or foreign bookings reconnect forever (backoff up to 15 s) and poll every 10 s. Fix: accept() then close(4403), or stop retrying after N handshake failures.

ui_bugs.issue: Does not handle detail objects like {code, message}, so backend errors show as 'HTTP 400' (seen on SEND booking error).
Debug text in English is visible to users: '2 pts · 2 route · no driver'.
After the booking reaches a terminal state (cancelled), the socket stays open and the header still shows 'En direct'. Close the WS once terminal.

integration_issues.issue: See backend critical items. Fix in book.tsx (send service_type 'multiple_shipments' when drops.length>1 and top-level drop = drops[0]) or relax the backend to honour stops[] for any service with drop = first leg. Vehicle eligibility for multiple_shipments matches moto (bike, three_wheeler, mini_truck, truck), but other services such as fresh_products/cargo would need their own handling.

Both orders are created, but the app goes to /order/mart/<id> (first created), not the SHOP order. The SHOP order is only reachable from Activity. Acceptable, but consider a multi-order confirmation screen.

Item title is in English ('Premium Motorcycle Parts & Accessories') although the UI is French and title_fr exists
Package type, weight and preference chips are in English (Documents, Food Package, Up to 5 kg, Call before...) in the French UI; send name_fr or a localised label
Category tiles all use the same generic bag icon (no images)
Several products have blank image placeholders (e.g. 'Weekend Autres accessoires auto', 'Essentiel Outils & entretien')

critical_code_review_comments: book.tsx: `multi` is true for any service with >1 drop, but the payload keeps service_type=service and drop=drops[last]. Neither matches the backend contract

CartContext.reload: the guest SHOP merge posts each line with .catch(()=>{}) and then always removes guest_shop_cart, so failed merges are silently lost. Concurrent reload() calls (setShopQty→reload) could also double-post guest lines before the key is removed
useBookingSocket: setLastFix is called inside a setState updater (side effect in a reducer; can double-fire in StrictMode)
SEND receiver phone is sent raw ('0701020304') without the country dial code
